ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 148 of 2019 (Unified Companies Law) and its Executive Regulations (UBO register and piercing obligations to GAFI); Law No. 80 of 2002 (Anti-Money Laundering Law), as amended, and its Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 3256 of 2003, as amended); Central Bank of Egypt CFT/KYC Consolidated Rules (updated 2021); Law No. 34 of 1970 (Commercial Registry Law); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and apostilled copy of the shareholder's passport (natural-person UBO/shareholder)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public and Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Hague Convention 1961 - Egypt is Contracting Party since December 2021)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney from each foreign shareholder appointing the Egyptian law firm/representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for non-Hague countries

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Extract from the registry for each corporate shareholder (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank letter confirming source of funds and non-Sanctions/PEP status of the investing entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (bank officer's signature legalized)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Arabic translations of all above documents for Egyptian Notary Public and GAFI files
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Egyptian legal translator (under NOT; attested by the Notary Public)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: National authentication and notarial certification (no apostille required)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory and documented screening, before incorporation acceptance, of every shareholder, director, and UBO against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU consolidated Targets List, UK HM Treasury Consolidated Sanctions List, H5? Egypt's designated persons list issued by EMLCU and the Arab League sanctions framework. PEP status must be sought by self-declaration + positive-hit verification; Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) applies to PEP/non-resident UBOs; source-of-wealth information and bank reference letters must be kept in the CDD file for at least 5 years after the termination of the business relationship (AML Law No. 80 of 2002, Article 19).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended by Law No. 7 of 1998 and Law No. 2 of 2018; Executive Regulations issued by the Ministry of Investment; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (for the foreign-owned LLC) and its Executive Regulations; relevant provisions of the Civil Code on corporate contracts.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registry Department, Cairo; in coordination with the GAFI One-Stop-Shop for foreign investors
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association (Aqd al-Taasis) and Articles of Association (Nizam al-Taasis), signed by all founding members, certified by a licensed Arabic notary, and filed with the GAFI Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Law No. 159 of 1981 for a restaurant LLC; however foreign capital must be deposited in a blocked Egyptian-pound bank account in the company's name at a licensed Egyptian bank, and an initial paid-in capital sufficient for the first six months of operations is required to satisfy the GAFI registration officer. Each subscriber must contribute at least one share; 50% of the subscribed capital is generally payable at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned founding shareholders, having incorporated Egypt Hotpot Overseas LLC, do hereby resolve: (1) adopting the Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed with GAFI; (2) confirming subscription of all shares of the company's initial share capital as set forth in the founding instrument; (3) designating the registered office at the executive offices in New Cairo, with authority to open branch premises in the licensed governorate; and (4) appointing the General Manager and the Chief Financial Officer as directors/officers for the first three-year term, authorizing each to open bank accounts, sign lease agreements, and pursue all operational licenses, effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reservation of Draft Company Name and Trade Name Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Companies Registry / Egyptian Commercial Registry Pre-Check Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed names (English and Arabic) through the GAFI online portal or in person at the One-Stop-Shop. Obtain a name availability certificate and a preliminary GAFI clearance for the proposed name 'EG Hotpot Overseas LLC'
required_dossiers: Notarized passport copies of each founder/member
Signed name reservation application (Form 1)
Board resolution or authorization letter appointing the formation agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name is rejected due to similarity, file a written appeal with the GAFI Name Review Committee within 5 working days and resubmit up to three alternative names in the same application batch

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Public Notary Office (Al-Shahr Al-Aqari) or GAFI-authorized in-house notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with GAFI's standard templates, specifying the LLC's name, capital, share allocation, activity code, and management structure. All founders or their legal attorneys must sign before a public notary, and the notary certifies the signatures
required_dossiers: Name availability certificate from Step 1
Fully drafted Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic, prepared by an Egyptian attorney
Passport copies and power-of-attorney documents for each foreign founder
Certified foreign registration document (if any corporate shareholder)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies incomplete corporate details or defective powers of attorney, cure by filing supplementary instrument (Taw'iyya) or corrected power of attorney; the notary will annotate the file and a new notarization date is assigned

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the Blocked Escrow Bank Account and Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian Commercial Bank (e.g. National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr) - Corporate Banking Branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Memorandum to the chosen bank to open a temporary company account. Deposit the subscribed initial capital in Egyptian pounds (or transfer equivalent in foreign currency). Obtain a Certificate of Deposit and a letter from the bank confirming the account number and actual paid-up capital for GAFI
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Founder passport copies
Draft tax card registration application (form No. 5)
Source-of-funds statement and bank reference letters
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires additional ownership disclosure, provide a GAFI ownership declaration and certified residency proof; if the deposit is rejected due to currency control, apply for an investment (Security) account under GAFI investment rules to permit foreign currency deposit and conversion

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation File to GAFI and Registration in Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Companies Registry - Commercial Registry and Firms Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation application through GAFI's One-Stop-Shop, submitting the notarized Memorandum, bank capital certificate, name approval, and legal form application. GAFI reviews, records the company in the Companies Registry, and assigns a commercial registration number. Thereafter the company receives its establishment contract certified and Commercial Registry extract
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association in three originals
Bank certificate of paid-up capital
Name reservation certificate
Notarized powers of attorney for all signatories
Foreign founders' passport copies
Application form for incorporation (GAFI Form 6)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI returns the file with a compliance query, remedy by submitting clarified documents and any required declarations (e.g. shareholder register or leased premises proof) within 10 working days; GAFI's legal directorate may issue a formal decision, with an appeal to the ministerial grievance committee if registration is refused

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Obtaining Tax Cards
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Taxpayer Registration Department; and later the local Tax Authority of the relevant governorate branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the commercial registration extract and incorporation contract to ETA to obtain a permanent tax card, VAT registration (if taxable sales exceed threshold, mandatory for restaurant operations), withholding tax registration, and payroll registration. Obtain the company charter from the commercial registry to finalize these filings
required_dossiers: Commercial Registry extract
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Lease contract for the registered office and/or the restaurant premises
Bank account certificate
ID and qualification documents of the directors
Application forms (VAT registration form 1, wage declaration form)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is rejected because the premises lease is incomplete, provide a valid landline utility bill and an official governorate lease registration; if VAT is denied pending activity verification, request an inspection from ETA and supply the Zoning license application acknowledgment

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Update and Publication of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Companies Registry together with the Official Gazette (Al-Waqa'i Al-Misriyya)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After GAFI grants incorporation, file the final articles for publication in the official commercial registry bulletin. Obtain the final Companies Registry extract (Al-Amayyia) and an official publication receipt. Publish a summary of the incorporation in the Official Gazette where required for third-party effect
required_dossiers: GAFI registration certificate
Commercial registration number and extracts
Board resolution appointing managers
Notarized signatures of managers
Proof of payment of publication fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed or rejected due to formatting, cure by resubmitting the Arabic summary in the prescribed font and format; if the Gazette rejects the application for missing corporate registry stamps, obtain the stamps from GAFI and resubmit within 5 days

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Governorate Licensing Department (Commercial/Occupational Licensing), the Egyptian Food Safety Authority (FSA), and the Ministry of Local Development - Central Licensing Authority
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Commercial and Occupational Operating License (Ihsha wa Tarikh) for Hotpot Restaurant Activities, including a Food Establishment Health License and a Hawking / Premises License

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Environmental Licensing Directorate, Cairo and Giza Governorate branches
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B-2: EIA Registration / Screening Report required for food and beverage services (ISIC 5610), not a Full EIA Report unless the facility includes a centralized central kitchen or exceeds a 200-seat capacity or high-water-use threshold; then a Full Environmental Impact Assessment is required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater must comply with Law 93 of 1962 for sewer discharge (BOD ≤ 600 mg/l, TSS ≤ 350 mg/l, oil and grease ≤ 100 mg/l); kitchen exhaust VOCs and smoke must comply with Law 9 of 2009 / Environmental Law 4 of 1994 amendments (opacity less than 20% and odor acceptable to the local authority); food waste and used condiment oil must be stored in sealed containers and disposed through an approved licensed waste collector with a monthly manifest

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety and Prevention Certificate from the Civil Defense Authority of the governorate (covering fire extinguishers, emergency exits, gas isolation valves for hotpot burners, and evacuation plan) prior to opening; Structural Load Inspection Certificate from the governorate's Engineering Administration confirming the premises can support kitchen equipment and heavy dining fixtures; Occupational Safety and Health clearance from the Ministry of Manpower (QSAS standard) for worker protection, including kitchen electrical grounding, gas line testing, and a workplace health clearance for staff food handling per FSA requirements

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) under the Ministry of Finance; statutory web portal: eta.gov.eg, including the unified electronic tax services portal 'Ingez (إنجز)' to which the e-invoicing and e-receipt clearance APIs are connected.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The foreign-owned EG LLC must first incorporate through the General Authority for Investment and Foreign Trade (GAFI) and obtain the commercial register extract. It then applies, through the ETA Ingez portal, for a single unified Tax Number (TIN, formerly the tax card 'بطاقة ضريبية') covering income tax, VAT, stamp duty and payroll taxes, submitting the GAFI investment certificate or commercial registration, constitutional documents, board resolution appointing Egyptian authorized signatories, accounting office mandate and bank account details; a licensed Egyptian tax agent must be appointed under notarized power of attorney for non-resident shareholders. VAT registration is completed in the same unified file; the ETA issues the tax card and VAT certificate before taxable supply commences. The condiment production activity additionally requires food-safety registration with the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA), whose license code is disclosed to ETA for the VAT file.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not recognize US-style check-the-box elections; entity classification follows the Companies Law and Law No. 91 of 2005, so the LLC is a resident juridical person taxed at entity level on worldwide income with a unilateral foreign tax credit for overseas hotpot branch profits. Available elections: (1) simplified presumptive-turnover tax for small taxpayers (annual turnover within the ministerial ceiling, generally EGP 2 million); (2) free-zone/investment-zone export regime (including SCZone free-zone treatment for export-oriented condiment production); (3) cash-basis election for qualifying micro-businesses; (4) thin-capitalization, hybrid-mismatch and GAAR-responsive safe-harbour elections, including group financing coordination. No pass-through election is available to shareholders.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under Law No. 67 of 2016, administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration when the taxable turnover of goods exceeds EGP 500,000 or taxable services (including restaurant/dining and managing services) exceed EGP 250,000 in the preceding 12 months; a condiment exporter and overseas-restaurant supply chain should register voluntarily even below the threshold to secure refundable input VAT. One unified Tax Number covers the entire VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: ETA has implemented mandatory e-invoicing and e-receipt phases for VAT-registered taxpayers; the hotpot restaurant's ERP and POS systems must integrate with ETA REST/JSON APIs, submit invoice and B2C receipt objects for near-real-time clearance, obtain ETA digital signatures and QR stamps, and follow the offline contingency guidance. The POS dining channel must use ETA-approved e-receipt software. Non-integration or issuance of unstamped invoices is penalized by ETA (fixed monetary fines per document, suspension of tax cards and customs processing) and may block VAT refunds.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Law No. 67 of 2016 and its Executive Regulations, 0% VAT applies to (a) tangible goods (condiment products, sauces, packaged hotpot meal kits) actually exported and customs-cleared out of Egypt, and (b) services (dining-management, franchising and offshore catering services) provided to non-resident recipients and wholly consumed outside Egypt. The exporter must be VAT-registered, issue zero-rated e-invoices with the export code, physically move the goods out of Egypt within the statutory export period, and prove receipt of the export proceeds in convertible foreign currency through the Egyptian banking system. Directly related support services and international transportation of the exported condiments are equally zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (single administrative document lodged through the Nafeza/ACID customs platform, with HS codes and weights)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill or international road carriage (CMR) document evidencing actual departure from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by the Egyptian bank confirming credit of export proceeds in convertible foreign currency
ETA 0% export VAT invoice, packing list, sales contract, GAFI export records and NFSA lot-release certificates for the food consignments
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA audits export dossiers end-to-end, reconciling the customs exit confirmation, transport documents, proceeds entry and e-invoice codes, and may trace goods to the overseas outlet. If actual exportation or repatriation is not proven, the 0% rate is reversed, VAT is assessed at 14% on the full invoice value with monthly delay additions and default penalties, refunds are clawed back with interest and prior periods may be reopened for up to five years; deliberate misdescriptions attract customs penalties, Criminal Code and VAT evasion fines (including imprisonment upon conviction), and the Central Bank of Egypt may impose exchange-control penalties for unrepatriated proceeds and the LLC may lose export/SCZone facilities.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE / Al-Bank Al-Markazi Al-Masri), operating under Law No. 194 of 2020 (Central Bank and Banking System Law), together with the CBE consolidated foreign-exchange rules issued in 2024 and the CBE Rule Book for Banks, Part 3 (Foreign Exchange Operations).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The EGP is convertible on the current account for trade and service payments through CBE-authorized banks, subject to documentary verification (contracts, invoices, tax card, and bank trade forms). The capital account is only partially open: foreign equity must enter through GAFI-registered channels exclusively via the banking system, with an inward transfer certificate; dividend and liquidation proceeds of an Egyptian LLC are freely repatriable after tax clearance under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, Art. 4, plus CBE evidence of source and profit computation. Egyptian residents making outward direct investment, including the overseas hotpot branch network, require CBE approval or registration within the bank's FX budget; any settlement outside the authorized banking system is criminally sanctioned.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Since the March 2024 unified managed float, there is no fixed mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts; however, all export and service proceeds must be repatriated through an authorized bank within the CBE-declared deadlines (generally 90 days from shipment or customs release for goods and 60 days from invoice or completion for services), with the transaction reported under the NAFEZA/ACI framework for goods. For the overseas restaurant chain, management fees, royalties, and branch remittances must enter Egypt through a licensed bank and be recorded in foreign-currency accounts; late or offshore-only receipts may trigger CBE fines, denial of import facilities, and exchange-control enforcement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital escrow / paid-up capital account and EGP+USD operational accounts
EGP/USD operational treasury account; inward FDI registration and remittance account
Cross-border clearing, FX dealer line, and multicurrency operational account
SWIFT gpi treasury account and dual-currency settlement account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Qatar National Bank Al Ahli S.A.E. (QNB AlAhli)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Trade finance and import-form settlement account (Form 4 / LC window)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Alexandria S.A.E. (Intesa Sanpaolo Group)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Egyptian fintech/EMI licensees (Paymob, Telda, MNT-Halan) operate only as payment and acquiring services and cannot clear EGP cross-border or extend FX lines. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Currencycloud) are legally unviable as primary treasury rails because Egyptian exchange-control law requires all resident B2B flows to pass through CBE-authorized banks; offshore EGP settlement is unavailable and such routing creates unreported FX exposure. At most, foreign EMIs may serve the non-Egyptian operating entities of the overseas restaurant chain for foreign-currency collections, never the Egyptian LLC's EGP treasury.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one Egyptian-resident authorized signatory (general manager or local board member) must appear physically at the branch. The CBE KYC framework permits non-resident directors and beneficial owners to attend interview by recorded video, but their corporate resolutions and identification documents must be original, apostilled or consular-legalized at the Egyptian mission in the jurisdiction of issuance, and accompanied by sworn Arabic translations. Pure remote onboarding of a foreign-managed LLC is not accepted by Egyptian banks; digital opening is generally reserved for Egyptian nationals and existing bank clients.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound equity injection from a non-resident shareholder into a newly formed LLC, flagged because capital is admitted before commercial history is established.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Articles of Association and GAFI company certificate; source-of-funds package (3-6 months bank statements of the transferor, audited parent financials, share purchase agreement); UBO declaration and group structure chart; CBE inward-transfer certificate; sworn Arabic legalization of all foreign documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-intensive restaurant operations: daily POS settlements, cash takings, and high-volume dining transactions creating potential layering risk through the till.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid restaurant license from the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities; POS merchant agreement and daily settlement statements; Egyptian Tax Authority electronic-invoicing records; cash register reconciliation policy; audited financial statements and VAT filing trail; documented ISIC 5610 concept of operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outward trade disbursements to overseas hotpot equipment, condiment, and seafood suppliers, exposing the bank to invoice mispricing or missing documentary end-use.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: NAFEZA import registration (ACI) reference; proforma and commercial invoices; bank Form 4 import declaration and CIF valuation; letter of credit or TT instruction with CBE transaction code; transport documents; supplier beneficial-ownership KYC; sanctions and PEP screening output.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or senior management connected to higher-risk jurisdictions (GCC, China, Russia-linked financing of the overseas chain) generating adverse-media hits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO register with certificates of good standing; independent global sanctions and adverse-media screening; enhanced due diligence questionnaire; source-of-wealth letter from external counsel; confirmation of no politically exposed persons or watch-list designations; CBE AML Unit clearance in red-flag cases.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The offshore investor remits in USD, EUR, or GBP via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code '701 – direct investment' to the LLC's foreign-currency account at an authorized Egyptian bank. The bank issues an inward transfer certificate and reports the deal to the CBE foreign-exchange reporting system; if the remittance constitutes a capital increase, GAFI registration and updated Articles of Association must precede conversion into EGP. Supporting file: investment registration certificate, board resolution, source-of-funds evidence, and UBO declarations. Shareholder loans and convertible instruments must be separately documented, transfer-priced, and reported to CBE; cash equity injections without banking record are non-compliant.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing-rail hierarchy: (1) SWIFT MT103/gpi TT for operating payments and service fees below the bank's documentary threshold after submission of invoice, contract, tax card, and Form 4 where goods are involved; (2) irrevocable, confirmed commercial letters of credit (MT700/MT720) for high-value kitchen and capital imports, released against NAFEZA ACI registration and customs clearance; (3) CBE-approved FX transfers for payments exceeding USD 1,000,000 or extending beyond 12 months; (4) domestic EGP settlement via CBE RTGS and Meeza rails for local suppliers and merchant reimbursements. All outbound flows require end-use documentation, bank-side screening, and five-year record retention.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore outright FX forward (USD/EGP) with a licensed Egyptian bank against genuine trade or repatriation exposure; tenor up to 6 months, margined at 10-20%, and prohibited for speculative dealing.
FX swap (USD/EGP and cross-currency swap) for cash-flow matching of import payables against local EGP dining revenue; requires board authorization and trade-ticket support.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on EGP are prohibited onshore for Egyptian residents; only non-resident counterparties may access the offshore EGP NDF market, and the Egyptian LLC cannot enter such contracts.

Currency options and structured FX hedges are not standardized in Egypt and are executed only under bank-specific ISDA/CSA documentation with CBE approval; forward and swap cover is the intended maximum sophistication for a restaurant treasury.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (ETA Form 41) with audited financial statements and tax reconciliation schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the fiscal year; 30 April for calendar-year entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory late-filing penalties are imposed by the ETA, including a monthly delay fine on the unpaid tax; continued non-filing exposes the company to enforced tax assessment, seizure of bank accounts, and suspension of the commercial registration certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements, manager's report, and members' approval resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) / Company Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the statutory period following the ordinary general meeting of members, and not later than 6 months after the fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit the annual audited financial statements with GAFI triggers administrative fines and warnings; persistent default may result in suspension of corporate licenses and administrative strike-off from the Commercial Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registry renewal declaration and trade license activity confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the anniversary date of initial commercial registration, unless the license cycle prescribes an earlier date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal accrues graduated administrative surcharges; prolonged non-renewal can lead to cancellation of the commercial registration, loss of the entity's legal capacity, and enforcement action against directors and managers.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent certified auditor is mandatory for all Egyptian LLPs whose paid-up capital exceeds EGP 1,000,000, annual turnover exceeds EGP 10,000,000, or employee headcount exceeds 50; additionally, entities with any non-resident shareholder or holding a GAFI license are generally required to undergo a statutory audit irrespective of turnover.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) issued by the Egyptian Accounting Standards Board; IFRS is permitted or required for entities with foreign parent reporting and consolidated financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC manager must maintain a current beneficial ownership register and confirm its accuracy annually at the time of filing the audited financial statements with GAFI. Any transfer of LLC quotas must be evidenced by a notarized agreement, recorded in the Register of Members, and reported to the Commercial Registry / GAFI within 30 days of the transfer; the annual confirmation serves as the manager's declaration of the identity, nationality, and pro-rata ownership percentage of all ultimate beneficial owners.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions

approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
